name: lipsync
description: Make a pixel-art character speak in sync with real audio: narrate text with a local model on Apple Silicon, get phoneme timestamps, turn them into a viseme frame plan, build a PixelLab mouth-shape sheet, render an MP4 or a web player, and export a device pack that an ESP32 with a 1-bit OLED or an M5Stack StickS3 plays
